In this vignette, we make all the GSVA score based pathway plots shown in the various main and supplemental figures of the paper. 

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggpubr)

s1 = 2# size for points in PCA plot
legend_pt_size =4
plot_title_size = 25
axis_text_size = 25
axis_title_size=25
legend_text_size=25
plot_text = 10
spacing=1
chosen_margin = c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5)# margins:top,right,bottom,left
theme_clean <- theme_bw() +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0, vjust=0, 
                                  lineheight=.8, face="bold", size=plot_title_size ),
        plot.margin=unit(chosen_margin,"cm"), 
        legend.text=element_text(size=legend_text_size),
        legend.key.height = unit(spacing, "cm"),
        #legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.2) ,
        legend.title=element_blank() , 
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(), 
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank())




myPalette2 <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")))
pathwy_sc <- scale_colour_gradientn(colours = myPalette2(20), limits=c(-1, 1))

print_mypathway = function(want, want_title){
    
    want = sapply(strsplit(want," R-HSA-"), function(x) x[1] )
    want = gsub( " ", "_", want)
    want = gsub( "-", "_", want)
    midx = sapply(want, function(x)  grep(toupper(x), rownames(score))[1] )
    midx = unlist(midx)
    
    midx = na.omit(midx)
    
    want_title= names(midx)
    
    L1 = lapply(1:length(midx), function(idx){
        z = midx[idx]
        PATHName = want_title[idx]
        mat = as.data.frame(cbind( umap_data2, GSVA = unlist(score[z,])))  
        
        max1 = max(mat$GSVA)
        min1= min(mat$GSVA)
        
        myPalette2 <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")))
        pathwy_sc2 <- scale_colour_gradientn(colours = myPalette2(20), limits=c(min1, max1))
        
        p1= ggplot(mat, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=GSVA )) +
            geom_point(size=2) + 
            pathwy_sc2 +
            ggtitle(paste0(PATHName)) + theme_clean + 
            theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.3) )
        p1
    })
}

qual_col_pals = brewer.pal.info[brewer.pal.info$category == 'qual',]
col_vector = unlist(mapply(brewer.pal, qual_col_pals$maxcolors, rownames(qual_col_pals)))

setwd("~/HollandLabShared/Ramya/breast_landscape/Sonali_final_data/Objects")

resdir = "~/HollandLabShared/Ramya/breast_landscape/Sonali_final_data/Figures"
score = readRDS("pathways.rds")
umap_data2 =read.delim("final_metadata_file_5_21_2026.txt", header=T, stringsAsFactors=F)


## fig 3
paths = c(  
    "GO_COLLAGEN_ACTIVATED_TYROSINE_KINASE_RECEPTOR_SIGNALING_PATHWAY",
    "GO_POSITIVE_REGULATION_OF_ERK1_AND_ERK2_CASCADE",
    "REACTOME_MET_ACTIVATES_PI3K_AKT_SIGNALING", 
    "REACTOME_ANDROGEN_BIOSYNTHESIS",
    "KEGG_STEROID_BIOSYNTHESIS")
wtitle_name = paths
k1 = print_mypathway(want  = paths, want_title = gsub("REACTOME_|GO_", "", paths ))
pdf(file.path( "../breast_Figures/Multiplot_final_Fig3_8_6_2026.pdf"), height = 20, width = 16)
ggarrange( plotlist = k1 , nrow =4, ncol =3)
k2 = lapply(k1, function(x) x+ ggtitle(""))
ggarrange( plotlist = k2 , nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()


## fig 4
path1= c(
    "REACTOME_G2_PHASE" ,
    "REACTOME_UNWINDING_OF_DNA",
    "HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT")
path2 = c("REACTOME_PD_1_SIGNALING", 
          "GO_REGULATION_OF_CHRONIC_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE", 
          "GO_ADAPTIVE_IMMUNE_RESPONSE" )

k1 = print_mypathway(want  = path1, want_title = gsub("REACTOME_|GO_", "", paths ))
k2 = print_mypathway(want  = path2, want_title = gsub("REACTOME_|GO_", "", paths ))

myPalette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(5, "YlOrRd"))# for gene expression
ylim = max(umap_data2$purity)
ylow = min(umap_data2$purity)
sc <- scale_colour_gradientn(colours = myPalette(5), limits=c(0.25, 0.9))     
p1 = ggplot(umap_data2, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=purity )) +
    geom_point(size=2) + 
    sc +
    ggtitle( "Purity" ) + theme_clean + 
    theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.3) )

l1 = ggplot(umap_data2, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=Science_Tcell_inflamed_GEP_PMID_30309915 )) +
    geom_point(size=2) + 
    pathwy_sc +
    ggtitle( "Tcell inflammed" ) + theme_clean + 
    theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.3) )

l2 = ggplot(umap_data2, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=Lung_5gene_tumor_purity_immune_PMID_PMC8216812 )) +
    geom_point(size=2) + 
    pathwy_sc +
    ggtitle( "High Immune/Low purity" ) + theme_clean + 
    theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.3) )

t1  = ggplot(umap_data2, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=inflam_tam )) +
    geom_point(size=2) + 
    pathwy_sc +
    ggtitle( "inflam_tam" ) + theme_clean + 
    theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.3) )

t3  = ggplot(umap_data2, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=IFN_TAM )) +
    geom_point(size=2) + 
    pathwy_sc +
    ggtitle( "IFN_TAM" ) + theme_clean + 
    theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.3) )

t6  = ggplot(umap_data2, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=folr2 )) +
    geom_point(size=2) + 
    pathwy_sc +
    ggtitle( "FOLR2 tam" ) + theme_clean + 
    theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.3) )

ppbc_fig =ggplot(umap_data2, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=PPBCVSNPBCUP )) +
    geom_point(size=2) + 
    pathwy_sc +
    ggtitle( "PPBC " ) + theme_clean + 
    theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.3) )

pdf(file.path( "../breast_Figures/Multiplot_final_Fig4_8_6_2026.pdf"), height = 20, width = 16)
a1 = list(k1[[1]], k1[[2]], k1[[3]], 
          l1, l2, p1, 
          k2[[1]], k2[[2]], k2[[3]],
          t6,t1, t3
)
ggarrange( plotlist = a1 , nrow =4, ncol =3)
k2 = lapply(a1, function(x) x+ ggtitle(""))
ggarrange( plotlist = k2 , nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()

## Supp Fig 4c           

st1  = ggplot(umap_data2, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=REG_TAM )) +

    pathwy_sc +
    ggtitle("REG_TAM" ) + theme_clean + 
    theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.3) )


st2  = ggplot(umap_data2, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=LA_TAM )) +
    geom_point(size=2) +

    ggtitle( "IFN_TAM" ) + theme_clean +

st3  = ggplot(umap_data2, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=RTM_TAM )) +
    geom_point(size=2) + 
    pathwy_sc +
    ggtitle("RTM_TAM" ) + theme_clean + 
    theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.3) )


st4  = ggplot(umap_data2, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=rtm_tam2 )) +

st15  = ggplot(umap_data2, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=ANGIO_TAM )) +

pdf(file.path( "../breast_Figures/Multiplot_final_supp_Fig4c_tams_8_6_2026.pdf"), height = 20, width = 16)
```
